disabled.subtitle: Invitation only
disabled.title: New staff accounts are by invitation
disabled.body: Self-service sign-up is currently closed. If you need access to the Vita NPD workspace, ask an existing teammate to send you an invite from the People settings — the invitation email will let you set up your account directly.

forgot_password.title: Reset your password
forgot_password.subtitle: Account recovery
forgot_password.body: Enter the email address you sign in with and we will send you a link to choose a new password. The link expires in 30 minutes.
forgot_password.sent_body: If an account with that email exists, we have just sent it a link to reset your password. The link is valid for 30 minutes.
forgot_password.sent_hint: Can't find it? Check your spam or junk folder — and if it lands there, marking it as 'Not junk' helps future emails arrive in your inbox.

reset_password.title: Choose a new password
reset_password.subtitle: Account recovery
reset_password.body: Pick a strong password you have not used here before. After saving, sign in with your new password.
reset_password.success_body: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new password to continue.

errors.missing_token: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one to continue.
errors.password_reset_token_invalid: This reset link is not valid. Request a new one to continue.
errors.password_reset_token_expired: This reset link has expired. Reset links are valid for 30 minutes — request a new one to continue.
errors.password_reset_token_used: This reset link has already been used. Request a new one if you still need to change your password.
errors.password_reset_token_invalidated: A more recent reset request has replaced this link. Use the latest email we sent, or request a new one.
